text:
JD Vance is reportedly building a new alliance after the midterm defeat.

A source told Fox News Digital that the Vice President is reaching out to disaffected Trump voters following the crushing Republican losses in the midterms.

via OSINT613

🚨 US special operations units are reportedly being moved to Israel right now.

Arab journalist Ali A.bk reports that American special forces units are currently being transferred into Israel, as US military reinforcements keep flowing toward the Middle East amid fears of a renewed US Iran war.

via AB4_Ali3

Trump wants to stop changing the clocks.

President Trump is pressing the Senate to pass the Sunshine Protection Act, which he calls the "I Don't Want to Change My Clocks Anymore Act." He says it is ridiculous that it gets dark so early, notes the House passed it 308 to 117, and vows to keep fighting for it.

via OSINT613

🚨 Trump's team is split on what comes next with Iran.

Some officials in the Trump administration are pushing the President toward new military strikes on Iran, while others want Washington to cut its losses and scale back operations against Tehran, The Wall Street Journal reports, citing US sources.

via AB4_Ali3

🚨 Names of Saudi soldiers reportedly killed in a Yemeni missile attack in Najran yesterday have been announced.

Those named are Hussein Mahdi Al Farwan, Naji Mabkhout Al Karbi, Saleh Abdullah Al Salem, Musfir Muhammad Al Muqrih, Saud Muhammad Al Dosari and Yahya Nasser Al Thawabi.

via AB4_Ali3

A photo from a past Al Quds Day parade in New York City appears to show Aber Kawas waving what has been described as a Hamas headband.

Kawas won New York State Senate District 12 on Tuesday.

via OSINT613

Ron Dermer draws a sharp line on Washington.

"We can deal with an anti Israel President. What we can't deal with is an anti American President."

via OSINT613

🚨 IRGC officer trains Iranian "Janfada" militia members in basic Kalashnikov handling as tension with the US keeps rising.

The volunteers appear armed with Romanian PM md. 63, East German MPi KM 72 and Chinese Type 56 rifles.

via war_noir

🚨 Minister Sultan Al Jaber at ADIPEC lays out the real cost of the Hormuz disruption.

Nearly 1 billion barrels have been drawn from reserves, diesel stocks sit at 35 year seasonal lows in some markets, LNG supply is short by 600 billion cubic feet, and oil logistics costs have jumped from under 5% to over 30% per barrel.

He urged diplomacy, strategic reserves and alternative supply routes, and announced ADNOC will be the first energy company to deploy OpenAI Frontier across its operations.

via OSINT613

Is Washington about to rethink its support for Israel?

Reuters reports that the Democratic takeover of Congress, combined with growing Republican unease over Israel, could trigger the biggest reassessment of US backing for its closest Middle East ally in decades, after an election shaped in part by anger over the Iran war.

via Reuters

Trump on whether JD Vance will run: "Maybe he won't run, I don't know."

The President also repeated that he would not have done anything differently in regards to the war.

via OSINT613

🚨 Iranians burn a poster of Trump, Vance, Netanyahu and Witkoff in Tehran.

New footage from Enqelab Square shows crowds celebrating the Republican midterm defeat by setting fire to an image of Donald Trump, JD Vance, Benjamin Netanyahu and envoy Steve Witkoff.

via OSINTWarfare

🚨 Tom Emmer is officially running for House minority whip after the GOP midterm defeat.

"We are down, but we are not out," the Republican Whip writes in a letter to colleagues, urging the party to unite.

via Fox News

🚨 Hakeem Jeffries officially launches his bid for Speaker of the House.

The New York Democrat makes his move after Democrats flipped both chambers of Congress in Tuesday's midterm elections, as his party prepares to take control of the House and Senate.

via Fox News

Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin sends a clear message after the midterms:

Deportations will continue.

via OSINT613

🚨 Israeli airstrikes pound southern Lebanon.

Lebanese reports say a large wave of Israeli strikes has hit several areas across the south within the last hour.

via OSINT613

Trump defends his tariffs.

Speaking to CNBC, President Trump warns: "If I took tariffs off? We have 3,000 plants under construction right now. Every single plant would stop building, right?"

via OSINT613

🚨 Update: Tampa Citibank shooting leaves 2 dead, including the suspect.

Florida authorities told AP the shooting happened Wednesday at a Citibank business complex in the Tampa area. Newly released footage shows the suspect stepping out of a vehicle and opening fire.

via https://t.co/F0PiRUNAmp

Israel's UN Ambassador Danny Danon slams Abdul El Sayed.

"He's an example of someone who will be against Israel regardless of what's happening in Israel, regardless of the fact that we have a ceasefire in Gaza. He's an antisemite, so it's going to be very hard to work with him."

🚨 Major US military reinforcements are heading toward the Middle East.

Flight tracking shows several US military transport aircraft crossing the Atlantic and Europe on their way to the region.

via AB4_Ali3
